> 6	// Camera fly-to rig (FR-047 / phase 3.6): eases the OrbitControls target (and the
> 7	// camera itself, keeping its current bearing at a fixed close-orbit distance)
> 8	// toward store.cameraTarget, then clears it on arrival. Runs inside the Canvas;
> 9	// requires <OrbitControls makeDefault /> so useThree exposes the controls.
> 10	// getState() inside useFrame — no React subscription churn per frame (Error #185 guard).
> 11	
> 12	const FLY_DISTANCE = 6; // close-orbit distance on arrival
> 13	const ARRIVE_EPS = 0.08;
> 14	
> 15	type OrbitControlsLike = { target: THREE.Vector3; update: () => void } | null;
> 16	
> 17	export function CameraRig() {
> 18	  const state = useThree();
> 19	  const controls = (state as any).controls as OrbitControlsLike;
> 20	  // Hoisted temp vectors — zero allocations inside the frame loop.
> 21	  const tmp = useMemo(() => ({ target: new THREE.Vector3(), desired: new THREE.Vector3(), dir: new THREE.Vector3() }), []);
> 22	
> 23	  useFrame(({ camera }) => {
> 24	    const { cameraTarget, setCameraTarget } = useUnifiedCanvasStore.getState();
> 25	    if (!cameraTarget || !controls) return;
> 26	    tmp.target.set(cameraTarget[0], cameraTarget[1], cameraTarget[2]);
> 27	
> 28	    controls.target.lerp(tmp.target, 0.09);
> 29	    // Desired camera spot: FLY_DISTANCE away from the node along the current view bearing.
> 30	    tmp.dir.copy(camera.position).sub(controls.target);
> 31	    const len = tmp.dir.length();
> 32	    if (len > 1e-4) tmp.dir.multiplyScalar(1 / len);
> 33	    tmp.desired.copy(tmp.target).addScaledVector(tmp.dir, FLY_DISTANCE);
> 34	    camera.position.lerp(tmp.desired, 0.07);
> 35	    controls.update();
> 36	
> 37	    if (controls.target.distanceTo(tmp.target) < ARRIVE_EPS) setCameraTarget(null);
> 38	  });
> 39	
> 40	  return null;
> 41	}

I'm tracking down six type issues across the codebase. First, there's a cast to `any` in UnifiedCanvasPage where `intel` is being used to call `analyzeNode` — I need to find where that comes from, probably a custom hook. Second, in MemoryPage there's an icon lookup that's typed too broadly as `React.ComponentType<any>` when it should be the more specific `LucideIcon` type from lucide-react.

For the third issue in SquadHull, I'm examining the `materialRef` for MeshDistortMaterial from drei — the type should be `React.forwardRef<DistortMaterialType, MeshDistortMaterialProps>`, and the code accesses `emissiveIntensity` which is inherited from MeshStandardMaterial. There's also a potential timing concern where `useFrame` references `materialRef` before it's declared, but that's actually safe because the callback executes after the component renders and the const is initialized.

For CrewGraph, the `React.createElement` cast with `as any` on ChromaticAberration suggests a type mismatch between the postprocessing library's Vector2 type and three's Vector2 — the JSX syntax would fail type-checking without the cast.

For CameraRig, the `(state as any).controls` cast indicates that RootState's `controls` property (which is `THREE.EventDispatcher | null`) doesn't match what the code expects to access.  I should check R3F's actual type definitions to see if using a selector with `useThree` and a proper type narrowing would be cleaner than the `as any` workaround.

</details>
